question: Does the union hold voter support levels, canvassing notes and elected-official contact records, who may read them, and under which privacy and political-finance rules?
decision: Disable voter support, canvassing profiles, elected-official profiling and political campaign interfaces at launch. Also disable political donation collection/receipting unless distinct counsel-approved jurisdictional eligibility, privacy, political-finance, payment and receipt controls are implemented and proven. Generic donation-campaign records must not silently provide a back door.
originalProposedDecision: Not at launch. No voter support levels or canvassing notes are held. Donation campaigns only; remove the political interfaces.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
approvedByRole: Founder & Product Owner, Nzila OS (Nzila Ventures) — platform/product only; contracting legal name unverified
